title: Mercury's Edge: A Liberty Thriller
hook: What if the metal that fuels your phone could end freedom forever?
story_text: In a near‑future city, the government replaces cash with a liquid metal called mercury, promising unlimited liberty through a single swipe. But the fluid seeps into every device, recording thoughts and movements. When activist Maya discovers the hidden code, she must outwit drones and a shadowy corporation before the mercury locks her mind, turning liberty into a silent, obedient whisper.
call_to_action: Will you dare to unplug before the mercury takes over?
engine: Nano Banana Pro AI Video Engine (Gemini 2.5 Flash + Flux)
